reported.title: No rate limit on fan toggles
reported.description: The sketch never enforces the 'max 2 state changes per 5000 ms' rule; rapid threshold crossings or boost release can toggle the fan more often than allowed.

reported.title: Boost release leaves fan stuck ON
reported.description: When boost is released, the hold counters are stale/zero and the fan stays ON until a fresh 4-sample OFF hold completes, but more importantly the forced-ON state isn't re-evaluated against temperature, so fan can remain ON below OFF_C for up to 200 ms and the boost override isn't cleanly cleared.

reported.title: ADC reference scaling assumes 5 V
reported.description: sampleTempC uses 5000 mV full-scale with 1023 divisor; on a 5 V Uno this is approximately correct but the divisor should be 1024 for proper LSB scaling, causing a small systematic temperature error near thresholds.

reported.title: Boost not debounced
reported.description: D4 is read directly each 50 ms sample with no debounce; a noisy or bouncing button can momentarily force the fan ON and count as a state change, violating the toggle-rate limit.

judge_input.spec:
- Temperature probe on A3 at 10 mV/°C; loft fan relay on D5; boost pushbutton on D4 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW).
- Turn the fan ON at 36.0 °C or above; turn it OFF at 32.0 °C or below.
- While D4 is held LOW, force the fan ON.
- Fan must not change state more than 2 times in any 5000 ms window.
- Print `loft: <temp> C fan=ON` or `loft: <temp> C fan=OFF` every 1000 ms.
- Apply fan changes within 500 ms of a sustained threshold crossing.
